boundary: First contacts are per-finger summed object normal loads >1mN, not raw individual contact points. Distal-pad surface distances are exact nearest triangles at saved actual poses, not contact-force or enclosure certificates. Object/palm coordinates use original saved pmbase-to-palm transform; preshape reference axes X=thumb-to-index, Z=approach; mesh vertices retain source scale.

summary.recommendation: The missing test is full closing-path/table/contact retention, rather than another forward, arbitrary force increase or treating objects as ungraspable. Existing static open-hand calibration is internally consistent but does not certify closing feasibility.
